domain_restrictions: n is an integer and n > 1
x + m is interpreted as a real number
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For every integer n with n greater than 1, for every real number x, and for every integer m, the equality E_n(x plus m) equals E_n(x) holds.

variables.name: x
variables.role: real input to the function E_n

variables.name: m
variables.role: integer shift applied to the real input x

witness_dependencies: none (no existential quantifiers; the equality must hold for every triple (n, x, m) in the specified domains)

statement_nl: For every integer n>1, every real number x, and every integer m, one has E_n(x + m) = E_n(x).
